intro: Trying to find USA scholarships for international students with August timing usually means balancing urgency with fit. This filtered view brings together a focused set of listings where deadline details are present, so you can compare options without jumping between unrelated results. The programs below span areas such as education, STEM, medicine, humanities, and community-focused awards, with study levels that can include graduate and high school applicants as well as adult learners. Award amounts vary widely by listing, and requirements are not uniform: some entries may ask for essays, while others appear lighter-touch. Because deadline wording differs by row and some opportunities may be coming up soon, it’s smart to apply early and review eligibility signals and provider-path context on the provider application path before you commit time to an application.
